learning_outcomes.text: Understand the foundations of relational databases, including the relational model, normalization, relational operations, the SQL language, transactions and concurrency control, and indexing.
Practice database concepts through the analysis, modeling and implementation of relational databases in a client-server setting.
Promote the acquisition of competences in analysis and synthesis.
Communicate effectively with experts and non-experts.

syllabus_topics: Overall View of the Database Systems: DBS, SQL, DB Applications, etc...
Complex relational integrity constraints: business rules
Relational Algebra and basic aspects of SQL
Inheritance and other advanced modeling techniques
Translation of ER Diagrams to Relational models
Execution and optimization of queries: basic aspects
Architecture and implementation details of a Database Server
teaching_methods: Theoretical-practical classes with detailed exposition using audiovisual media
bibliography: A. Silberschatz, H. F. Korth, S. Sudarshan, “Database System Concepts”, 7th Edition, McGraw Hill Education, 2019, https://www.db-book.com/db7/
C. Coronel, S. Morris, “Database Systems: Design, Implementation, and Management”, 12th Edition, Cengage Learning, 2017.
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
